_comment: HAND-HELD ECI FACTS THAT THE SCRAPER CANNOT DISCOVER — re-applied after EVERY refresh. WHY THIS FILE EXISTS: refresh_eci_map.py rebuilds eci_starlite_map.json's `acts` block ENTIRELY from the ECI search listing, and anything it does not find is DROPPED ('-N gone'). It runs DAILY (cron 07:30 Tue-Sun) and again every Monday inside generate.sh. So any URL, price or routing typed in by hand survives only until the next SUCCESSFUL refresh. Through late July 2026 that was masked: ECI had been returning 403 to the VPS since 27 Jul, every refresh failed, and the fail-safe kept the last-good map — so hand edits appeared to stick. The moment ECI unblocks the box, an unpinned hand edit vanishes. Tools/agent/patch_eci_aliases.py reads THIS file and re-applies it immediately after refresh, before enforce_eci_routing.py. PIPELINE ORDER IS DELIBERATE: refresh (scrape facts) -> patch (restore facts we hold and it cannot) -> enforce (apply the price rule to whatever facts now exist). That means a pin supplies FACTS (url / prices); the READER-FIRST PRICE RULE still wins on routing — enforce may flip `prefer` if the prices say the box office is cheaper, and that is correct. Never pin a `prefer` that makes a reader pay more. TO ADD A PIN: verify the URL in a browser first (ECI slugs are opaque and often wrong — see nina pastori below), then add the act key exactly as _eci_norm() would produce it.

nina pastori.why: Sofia 2026-07-31. ECI carries THREE Niña Pastori pages and only the DATED slug is our show. (a) ...-starlite-occident-2026-marbella/ -> 404, which is why the 2026-07-25 pass wrote her off as 'box-office only'. (b) ...-starlite-FESTIVAL-2026-marbella/ -> resolves but is the 27 JUNE concert and reads 'YA NO SE ENCUENTRA A LA VENTA' — sending an August buyer there is a dead end. (c) THIS one, with 21-08-26 in the slug -> 'Fechas: 21 de Agosto de 2026, 22:00, Desde 29,00 EUR, COMPRAR' (browser-verified 2026-07-31). She plays Starlite TWICE in 2026 (27 Jun + 21 Aug); our calendar row is the AUGUST date. refresh_eci_map.py has never found ANY of the three, so without this pin her entry has no url at all and routing falls back to the box office, which pays nothing. Prices are equal (29 = 29) so enforce_eci_routing sends it to ECI. BOTH SIDES ARE PINNED ON PURPOSE: if a refresh drops the act entirely, restoring only the ECI half leaves box_from unknown, enforce_eci_routing then cannot compare prices, `prefer` is never set, and venue_resolve (which requires prefer=='eci' AND a url) silently keeps the unpaid box-office link. Pinning box_url/box_from too lets enforce do its job.

mau y ricky.why: Calendar says 'Mau y Ricky'; ECI says 'Mau & Ricky'. _eci_norm() converts & -> 'and' but NOT 'y' -> 'and', so the calendar normalises to 'mau y ricky' and misses the scraped key. Without this alias the link stays on the unpaid box-office homepage.

alvaro de luna and nil moliner.from: alvaro de luna y nil moliner
alvaro de luna and nil moliner.why: ECI says 'Álvaro de Luna y Nil Moliner' -> normalises with 'y'. If the calendar carries the '&' form, _eci_norm converts & -> and, giving 'and' — a miss without this alias.

gloria trevi.why: ECI page OFF-SALE for the 24 Aug 2026 Starlite show — https://www.elcorteingles.es/entradas/conciertos/entradas-gloria-trevi-starlite-occident-2026-marbella/ shows 'Desde 29,00€' then the red banner 'YA NO SE ENCUENTRA A LA VENTA' / 'Actualmente este evento ya no se encuentra a la venta' with a dead buy box (browser-verified 2026-08-23) — the same failure shape as Antonio Jose 19 Aug, Nina Pastori 20 Aug and Pastora Soler 22 Aug. The Starlite box office still sells it: https://entradas.starlitemarbella.com/event/gloria-trevi-flyvkn — 08/24/2026 10:00 PM, seating plan and two live 'Buy tickets' controls (browser-verified 2026-08-23), and that is exactly the link venue_event_map already carries under starlite/gloria trevi. Exclude from ECI so the build falls back to the box office. Safe to remove after 24 Aug 2026.

antonio jose.why: ECI page OFF-SALE for the 20 Aug 2026 Starlite show — red banner 'Actualmente este evento ya no se encuentra a la venta' and the buy box is disabled ('YA NO SE ENCUENTRA A LA VENTA'), browser-verified 2026-08-19, even though the page's JSON-LD still says InStock at 21,00 EUR (stale). The Starlite box office still sells it: https://entradas.starlitemarbella.com/event/antonio-jose-z9htu9 — '20 DE AGOSTO', tickets start at 25,00 EUR, 'Buy tickets' live (browser-verified 2026-08-19), and that is exactly the link the calendar row already carries. enforce_eci_routing would pick ECI on price (21<25) but ECI is unbuyable, so exclude it and fall back to the box-office link. Safe to remove after 20 Aug 2026.

pastora soler.why: ECI page OFF-SALE for the 22 Aug 2026 Starlite show — https://www.elcorteingles.es/entradas/conciertos/entradas-pastora-soler-starlite-occident-2026-marbella/ shows the red banner 'Actualmente este evento ya no se encuentra a la venta' and a disabled buy box reading 'YA NO SE ENCUENTRA A LA VENTA' (browser-verified 2026-08-22), while its JSON-LD still says InStock at 25,00 EUR (stale) — the same failure shape as Antonio Jose 19 Aug and Nina Pastori 20 Aug. The Starlite box office still sells it: https://entradas.starlitemarbella.com/event/pastora-soler-vgvw2i — '22 DE AGOSTO', 08/22/2026 Sat 10:00 PM, Auditorio Marbella, 'Tickets start at EUR25.00' with a live 'Buy tickets' button (browser-verified 2026-08-22), and that is exactly the link venue_event_map already carries. Exclude from ECI so the build falls back to the box office. Safe to remove after 22 Aug 2026.

antonito molina.why: TWO Starlite dates (18 & 19 Aug 2026) but this map is act-keyed, so both calendar rows route to the SINGLE 18-08 ECI page and ECI has NO 19-08 page (404). Excluding from ECI routing lets each row keep its own date-correct Starlite box-office link (18/8 .../event/antonito-molina-opoj1x, 19/8 .../event/antonito-molina-wz9g60). Browser-verified 2026-08-05. Safe to remove after 19 Aug 2026.

hermanos martinez.why: ECI page OFF-SALE ('Actualmente este evento ya no se encuentra a la venta', browser-verified 2026-08-07) for the 7 Aug 2026 combined Starlite bill (Nil Moliner y Álvaro de Luna + Hermanos Martínez). Live-site row matched this ECI key via token-containment and shipped the off-sale ECI link. Starlite box office still sells the whole 7 Aug bill (https://entradas.starlitemarbella.com/event/nil-moliner-y-alvaro-de-luna-pqwrhm, browser-verified on sale 2026-08-07). Exclude so build falls back to the box-office link. Safe to remove after 7 Aug 2026.

gente de zona.why: ECI page OFF-SALE ('Actualmente este evento ya no se encuentra a la venta', browser-verified 2026-08-05) while the Starlite box office still sells (EUR41). enforce_eci_routing would pick ECI on price (29<41) but ECI is unbuyable, so exclude it and fall back to the box-office link. Safe to remove after 5 Aug 2026.

delaossa.why: ECI page OFF-SALE (browser-verified 2026-08-05); box office sells at the same EUR35. Exclude from ECI routing so the reader gets a working box-office link. Safe to remove after 6 Aug 2026.

sanguijuelas del guadiana.why: Co-billed with Delaossa on the SAME 6 Aug 2026 Starlite row (Delaossa + Sanguijuelas del Guadiana). With delaossa excluded, the double-bill row otherwise matches this ECI entry via token-containment and routes to Sanguijuelas ECI page (slug oddly dated 08-04, unverified). Exclude so the row falls back to the verified box-office link. No standalone Sanguijuelas calendar row exists. Safe to remove after 6 Aug 2026.

nina pastori.why: ECI page OFF-SALE for the 21 Aug 2026 Starlite show — the event's own buy box reads 'YA NO SE ENCUENTRA A LA VENTA' / 'Actualmente este evento ya no se encuentra a la venta', browser-verified 2026-08-20, even though its JSON-LD still says InStock (stale) at 29,00 EUR. Same failure shape as Antonio Jose on 2026-08-19. The Starlite box office still sells it: https://entradas.starlitemarbella.com/event/nina-pastori-nnlfec — 'Nina Pastori 21/8', 08/21/2026 10:00 PM, live seat map with 'Select seats' (browser-verified 2026-08-20), and that is the link venue_event_map already carries. Exclude from ECI so the build falls back to the box office. Safe to remove after 21 Aug 2026.

nile rodgers and chic.why: ECI page OFF-SALE for the 26 Aug 2026 Starlite show - https://www.elcorteingles.es/entradas/conciertos/entradas-nile-rodgers-chic-starlite-occident-2026-marbella-0000089pB0000089Nz000008546/ shows 'Fechas: 26 de Agosto de 2026', 'Desde 33,64 EUR', then the red banner 'Actualmente este evento ya no se encuentra a la venta' with a dead greyed buy box (browser-verified 2026-08-25). FIFTH ECI off-sale in a week (Antonio Jose 20 Aug, Nina Pastori 21 Aug, Pastora Soler 22 Aug, Gloria Trevi 24 Aug). ECI's own Starlite venue page carries only this one Nile Rodgers URL, so there is NO on-sale ECI alternative. DESTINATION IS TICKETMASTER, NOT THE BOX OFFICE (DLR, 2026-08-25): the box office pays no commission, so venue_event_map routes this act to Ticketmaster.es event 771593509 - 'Nile Rodgers & CHIC, Wed, 26 Aug 2026, 22:00, Auditorio Starlite, Marbella', live seat map, browser-verified - which pays through Impact/evyy.net. Safe to remove after 26 Aug 2026.

_exclude_note: exclude: acts that must NEVER route through ECI even when the price rule would pick it — because the ECI page is off-sale (enforce cannot see off-sale) or the act has multiple calendar dates a single act-keyed ECI url cannot serve. patch_eci_aliases.py removes these from the map AFTER refresh + pins/aliases and BEFORE enforce, so build_site falls back to each row's own calendar (box-office) link, every run. Verify in a browser before adding.
